mapper.select: SELECT A.ev_id, B.dv_id, B.dv_lat, B.dv_lng, G.boundary_json, P.vehicle_lat, P.vehicle_lng, P.heading FROM tbl_event_data A LEFT JOIN tbl_device B ON A.ev_dv_id = B.dv_id LEFT JOIN tbl_device_geofence G ON G.dv_id = B.dv_id LEFT JOIN tbl_event_vehicle_pose P ON P.ev_id = A.ev_id WHERE A.ev_id = #{evId} AND A.ev_is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_device_geofence (dv_id,boundary_json,updated_by) VALUES (#{deviceId},#{boundary},#{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE boundary_json=VALUES(boundary_json),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO tbl_event_vehicle_pose (ev_id,vehicle_lat,vehicle_lng,heading,updated_by) VALUES (#{evId},#{lat},#{lng},#{heading},#{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vehicle_lat=VALUES(vehicle_lat),vehicle_lng=VALUES(vehicle_lng),heading=VALUES(heading),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
